verdict.rationale: Helicone offers a REST API for querying/retrieving request data (JSON) and one-line export to PostHog, plus self-hosting options that let users keep their own data in open infra (Postgres/ClickHouse). However there's no explicit documented bulk 'export all your data' or account-portability feature, and the 'open source' framing itself was disputed by the community over licensing (Commons Clause), which weakens the openness narrative. Missing for 10: an explicit full-data export/download tool, documented data-portability guarantees, and independent confirmation that self-hosted/exported data is complete and usable outside Helicone.
